name: Editor UX Fix
description: Long-press a line to fold or unfold it (its parent if it has no children); click where the caret is to toggle the line; Alt+wheel (or wheel while holding the right button, on Windows) folds or unfolds the line under the mouse one level at a time, keeping the line under the mouse in place; the wheel left of the text (margin, indentation, list markers, heading #) does the same without Alt, a click there toggles the line, and a long-press there folds its parent; header buttons fold or unfold everything.
author: Hyunyoung Park
